verses.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
verses.pt: E Balaão disse a Balaque: Edifica para mim aqui sete altares, e prepara-me aqui sete bezerros e sete carneiros.
verses.en_web: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
verses.en_bbe: And Balaam said to Balak, Make me here seven altars and get ready seven oxen and seven male sheep.

verses.en: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.pt: E Balaque fez como lhe disse Balaão: e ofereceram Balaque e Balaão um bezerro e um carneiro em cada altar.
verses.en_web: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.
verses.en_bbe: And Balak did as Balaam had said; and Balak and Balaam made an offering on every altar of an ox and a male sheep.

verses.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
verses.pt: E Balaão disse a Balaque: Põe-te junto a teu holocausto, e eu irei: talvez o SENHOR me virá ao encontro, e qualquer um coisa que me mostrar, eu a contarei a ti. E assim se foi só.
verses.en_web: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps Yahweh will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.
verses.en_bbe: Then Balaam said to Balak, Take your place by your burned offering, and I will go and see if the Lord comes to me: and I will give you word of whatever he says to me. And he went to an open place on a hill.

verses.en: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.pt: E veio Deus ao encontro de Balaão, e este lhe disse: Sete altares ordenei, e em cada altar ofereci um bezerro e um carneiro.
verses.en_web: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”
verses.en_bbe: And God came to Balaam, and Balaam said to him, I have made ready seven altars, offering an ox and a male sheep on every altar.

verses.en: And the LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR pôs palavra na boca de Balaão, e disse-lhe: Volta a Balaque, e hás de falar assim.
verses.en_web: Yahweh put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord put words in Balaam's mouth, and said, Go back to Balak, and this is what you are to say.

verses.en: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.pt: E voltou a ele, e eis que estava ele junto a seu holocausto, ele e todos os príncipes de Moabe.
verses.en_web: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.en_bbe: So he went back to him where he was waiting by his burned offering with all the chiefs of Moab.

verses.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
verses.pt: E ele tomou sua parábola, e disse: De Arã me trouxe Balaque, rei de Moabe, dos montes do oriente: Vem, amaldiçoa para mim a Jacó; E vem, condena a Israel.
verses.en_web: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And in the words which the Lord had given him he said, From Aram Balak has sent for me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East: come, put curses on Jacob for me and be angry with Israel.

verses.en: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?
verses.pt: Por que amaldiçoarei eu ao que Deus não amaldiçoou? E por que condenarei ao que o SENHOR não condenou?
verses.en_web: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?
verses.en_bbe: How may I put curses on him who is not cursed by God? how may I be angry with him with whom the Lord is not angry?

verses.en: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.pt: Porque do cume das penhas o verei, E desde as colinas o olharei: Eis aqui um povo que habitará confiante, e não será contado entre as nações.
verses.en_web: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.
verses.en_bbe: From the top of the rocks I see him, looking down on him from the hills: it is a people made separate, not to be numbered among the nations.

verses.en: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
verses.pt: Quem contará o pó de Jacó, Ou o número da quarta parte de Israel? Morra minha pessoa da morte dos corretos, E meu fim seja como o seu.
verses.en_web: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”
verses.en_bbe: Who is able to take the measure of the dust of Jacob or the number of the thousands of Israel? May my death be the death of the upright and my last end like his!

verses.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
verses.pt: Então Balaque disse a Balaão: Que me fizeste? Tomei-te para que amaldiçoes a meus inimigos, e eis que proferiste bênçãos.
verses.en_web: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Balak said to Balaam, What have you done to me? I sent for you so that my haters might be cursed, and see, you have given them a blessing.

verses.en: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
verses.pt: E ele respondeu, e disse: Não observarei eu o que o SENHOR puser em minha boca para dizê-lo?
verses.en_web: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”
verses.en_bbe: And in answer he said, Am I not ordered to say only what the Lord puts into my mouth?

verses.en: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
verses.pt: E disse Balaque: Rogo-te que venhas comigo a outro lugar desde o qual o vejas; sua extremidade somente verás, que não o verás todo; e desde ali me o amaldiçoarás.
verses.en_web: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”
verses.en_bbe: And Balak said to him, Come with me now into another place from which you will not be able to see them all, but only the outskirts of them; and you will send curses on them from there.

verses.en: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.pt: E levou-o ao campo de Zofim, ao cume de Pisga, e edificou sete altares, e ofereceu um bezerro e um carneiro em cada altar.
verses.en_web: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
verses.en_bbe: So he took him into the country of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and there they made seven altars, offering an ox and a male sheep on every altar.

verses.en: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.
verses.pt: Então ele disse a Balaque: Põe-te aqui junto a teu holocausto, e eu irei a encontrar a Deus ali.
verses.en_web: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to Balak, Take your place here by your burned offering, while I go over there to the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR saiu ao encontro de Balaão, e pôs palavra em sua boca, e disse-lhe: Volta a Balaque, e assim dirás.
verses.en_web: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord came to Balaam, and put words in his mouth, and said, Go back to Balak, and this is what you are to say.

verses.en: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.pt: E veio a ele, e eis que ele estava junto a seu holocausto, e com ele os príncipes de Moabe: e disse-lhe Balaque: Que disse o SENHOR?
verses.en_web: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”
verses.en_bbe: So he came to him where he was waiting by his burned offering with the chiefs of Moab by his side. And Balak said to him, What has the Lord said?

verses.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
verses.pt: Então ele tomou sua parábola, e disse: Balaque, levanta-te e ouve; Escuta minhas palavras, filho de Zipor:
verses.en_web: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.
verses.en_bbe: And in the words which the Lord had given him he said, Up! Balak, and give ear; give attention to me, O son of Zippor:

verses.en: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.pt: Deus não é homem, para que minta; nem filho de homem para que se arrependa: ele disse, e não fará?; Falou, e não o executará?
verses.en_web: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not make it good?
verses.en_bbe: God is not a man, to say what is false; or the son of man, that his purpose may be changed: what he has said, will he not do? and will he not give effect to the words of his mouth?

verses.en: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
verses.pt: Eis que, eu tomei bênção: E ele abençoou, e não poderei revogá-la.
verses.en_web: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
verses.en_bbe: See, I have had orders to give blessing: and he has given a blessing which I have no power to take away.

verses.en: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
verses.pt: Não notou iniquidade em Jacó, nem viu perversidade em Israel: o SENHOR seu Deus é com ele, E júbilo de rei nele.
verses.en_web: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.
verses.en_bbe: He has seen no evil in Jacob or wrongdoing in Israel: the Lord his God is with him, and the glad cry of a king is among them.

verses.en: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
verses.pt: Deus os tirou do Egito; Tem forças como de boi selvagem.
verses.en_web: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
verses.en_bbe: It is God who has taken them out of Egypt; his horns are like those of the mountain ox.

verses.en: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
verses.pt: Porque em Jacó não há agouro, nem adivinhação em Israel: Como agora, será dito de Jacó e de Israel: O que fez Deus!
verses.en_web: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’
verses.en_bbe: No evil power has effect against Jacob, no secret arts against Israel; at the right time it will be said of Jacob and of Israel, See what God has done!

verses.en: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
verses.pt: Eis que o povo, que como leão se levantará, E como leão se erguerá: Não se deitará até que coma a presa, E beba o sangue dos mortos.
verses.en_web: Behold, the people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”
verses.en_bbe: See, Israel comes up like a she-lion, lifting himself up like a lion: he will take no rest till he has made a meal of those he has overcome, drinking the blood of those he has put to death.

verses.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
verses.pt: Então Balaque disse a Balaão: Já que não o amaldiçoas, nem tampouco o abençoes.
verses.en_web: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Balak said to Balaam, If you will not put a curse on them, at all events do not give them a blessing.

verses.en: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
verses.pt: E Balaão respondeu, e disse a Balaque: Não te disse que tudo o que o SENHOR me disser, aquilo tenho de fazer?
verses.en_web: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do?’”
verses.en_bbe: But Balaam in answer said to Balak, Did I not say to you, I may only do what the Lord says?

verses.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
verses.pt: E disse Balaque a Balaão: Rogo-te que venhas, te levarei a outro lugar; porventura comparecerá bem a Deus que desde ali me o amaldiçoes.
verses.en_web: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Balak said to Balaam, Come now, I will take you to another place; it may be that God will let you put a curse on them from there.

verses.en: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.pt: E Balaque levou a Balaão ao cume de Peor, que está voltado até Jesimom.
verses.en_web: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
verses.en_bbe: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, looking down over the waste land.

verses.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.pt: Então Balaão disse a Balaque: Edifica para mim aqui sete altares, e prepara-me aqui sete bezerros e sete carneiros.
verses.en_web: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
verses.en_bbe: And Balaam said to Balak, Make me seven altars here and get seven oxen and seven male sheep ready for me.

verses.en: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.pt: E Balaque fez como Balaão lhe disse; e ofereceu um bezerro e um carneiro em cada altar.
verses.en_web: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
verses.en_bbe: And Balak did as Balaam said, offering an ox and a male sheep on every altar.
